item.title: Fukubukuro Surprise Set
item.description:
Experience the joy of surprise and the spirit of Japanese tradition with our Fukubukuro Bundle, a curated collection of Snow Peak essentials. Meaning "lucky bag" in Japanese, Fukubukuro is a cherished New Year’s custom where shoppers purchase mystery bags filled with hidden treasures, symbolizing good fortune for the year ahead.


Bring this tradition to your campsite! Each bundle includes a selection of Snow Peak gear valued at over $200—an assortment of timeless, high-quality items designed to enhance your time outdoors. From practical tools to elegant pieces that embody Snow Peak’s Japanese craftsmanship and outdoor values, these surprises will elevate your camping experience, creating memories for years to come.

* This item is not eligible for return.

Variant:
Fukubukuro Surprise Set

item.title: Wabuki Chopsticks L in Black
item.description:
The Wabuki Chopsticks L in Black are a special, limited-edition version of the popular collapsible chopsticks in a sleek black colorway. Use the Wabuki Chopsticks L in Black for office lunches or campsite meals, then store them in the slim case. To collapse the chopsticks, unscrew the wooden tips, nest them inside the upper section, and tuck them into the carrying case for a compact dining utensil.

Variant:
Wabuki Chopsticks L in Black

item.title: Travel 2-Way Dry Bag
item.description:
The Travel 2-Way Dry Bag is a multifunctional, waterproof bag. Constructed from lightweight nylon ripstop, the bag features a rolltop closure on the main compartment with taped seams for airtightness and waterproofing. Additional features include a removable and adjustable shoulder strap and two side pockets with Velcro closures for phones and other small items.


Festival products are limited in quantity and will not be restocked.

Variant:
Travel 2-Way Dry Bag - Olive / One
Travel 2-Way Dry Bag - Black / One
Travel 2-Way Dry Bag - Grey / One

item.title: Titanium Backpackers Cup in Blue
item.description:
Designed and manufactured in Japan, the Titanium Backpackers Cup in Blue is made of durable titanium. Intended to be used for cooking and measuring, the Backpackers Cup features graduated measurement lines and a sturdy handle. The Ti-Backpackers Cup is ultralight, and the handle serves as a hook for easy carrying and storage. This special limited-edition version features a blue anodization.


Please note: using over a burner flame may cause discoloration to the anodized finish.

Variant:
Titanium Backpackers Cup in Blue

item.title: Titanium Straw Set
item.description:
The Titanium Straw 2-Piece Set is a limited-edition reusable drinking straw set. The straws are made of durable titanium that is flavor-resistant, so there is no metallic aftertaste. The Titanium Straw 2-Piece Set includes two bent straws in natural grey titanium.

Variant:
Titanium Straw Set

item.title: Stacking Mug Seppou H200 Blue
item.description:
The Ti-Double H200 Stacking Mug is made of Japanese titanium utilizing a historic manufacturing process. With its double-wall insulation, the H200 Stacking Mug is designed for hot and cold beverages. This special, limited-edition version features a vibrant blue anodization.


Please note: double-walled titanium cannot be used for cooking or placed over a heat source.

Variant:
Stacking Mug Seppou H200 Blue

item.title: Renewed Entry IGT in Black
item.description:
The Renewed Entry IGT features an updated design with improved functionality and reduced weight for easier transportation. Use the Entry IGT Table at home or outside for a low-height cooking and dining space. Add preferred inserts into the three units of space or simply use with the included bamboo surfaces as a standalone table. The Entry IGT Table features foldable legs for compact storage. This special, limited-edition version features a black powder coating on the metal frame for a sleek look.


Additional features include lighter laminated bamboo inserts, adjustable feet to accommodate mixed terrain, and an improved folding leg mechanism.

Variant:
Renewed Entry IGT in Black

item.title: Shimo Tumbler 360 Duo Set
item.description:
Shimo Tumbler 360 Duo Set includes two vacuum-insulated drinking vessels in limited-edition purple and light blue colorways. The tumblers are made of stainless steel and feature a non-slip silicone base and a stackable structure. The Shimo Tumbler 360 is a smaller version of the Shimo Tumbler. To clean, use mild soap and warm water.


Festival items are limited in quantity and will not be restocked.

Variant:
Shimo Tumbler 360 Duo Set

item.title: Mini Hozuki Lantern Shade Tsubomi
item.description:
The Mini Hozuki Lantern Shade Tsubomi is a washi paper shade designed to be used with the Mini Hozuki Lantern. This shade recreates the classic feel of a traditional paper lantern, offering gentle illumination and coloring, and is easily compacted for transport and storage.


Festival products are limited in quantity and will not be restocked.

Variant:
Mini Hozuki Lantern Shade Tsubomi

item.title: Micro Capsule Incense Case
item.description:
The Micro Capsule Incense Case is an incense holder based on the design of the cast iron Micro Capsule. Made from ceramic, the incense holder can be used to elevate your camping experience or bring the natural aromas of the forest into your home.


When in use, the lid and fire-resistant mat provide a space for your incense to burn, while the base can be used to store additional incense sticks and other small items like matches or a lighter. 30 sandalwood scented incense sticks are included.


Festival products are limited in quantity and will not be restocked.

Variant:
Micro Capsule Incense Case

item.title: Camping Embroidery Cap
item.description:
The Camping Embroidery Cap features a classic six-panel design, ventilated eyelets for breathability, and a curved visor. The rear includes a size-adjustable strap for a comfortable, unisex fit. A Snow Peak typographic logo and embroidered tent are featured on the front, with a simple typographic logo on the back.


Festival products are limited in quantity and will not be restocked.

Variant:
Camping Embroidery Cap - Brown / One
Camping Embroidery Cap - Black / One
Camping Embroidery Cap - Ivory / One
Camping Embroidery Cap - Charcoal / One

item.title: Folding Chair Leg Cap Set
item.description:
The Folding Chair Leg Cap Set adds traction and floor protection to the legs of the Folding Chair, allowing it to be used indoors. The material is made from a combination of hard and soft plastics for grip and durability, while the shape is designed to prevent the caps from slipping off accidentally.

Variant:
Folding Chair Leg Cap Set

item.title: Shelter Inner Duo
item.description:
The Shelter Inner Duo is a versatile freestanding inner tent that can be used with a variety of shelters. The frame features connected joints, making it easy to set up. The included groundsheet can be attached to the base of the tent, allowing it to be moved and repositioned within the shelter as a single piece. The tent features a passthrough section for wing poles when used with the Land Station.


Please note: the Shelter Inner Duo is designed to be used with a shelter and is not intended for standalone use. Four (4) pegs are required for setup, not included.

Variant:
Shelter Inner Duo

item.title: Urban Umbrella
item.description:
The Urban Umbrella is a convenient and easy-to-use umbrella for urban and camp environments. The umbrella features a PET resin sheet on the backside for easy opening and storage, while the ring hook at the base of the handle allows it to be easily hung from a table, coatrack, or accessory clip.

Variant:
Urban Umbrella

item.title: System Cooler 62
item.description:
The System Cooler 62 is a soft cooler with high insulation power. The cooler features an integrated heat shielding sheet and 20mm thick insulation, keeping the contents cold for up to two days at camp. The System Cooler 62 also features an interior mesh pocket for cooling packs, dual handles, and a double-zippered closure with an extra-wide opening.


The System Cooler 62 can also be used with one or two System Cooler 19s inside for greater cooling power.

Variant:
System Cooler 62

item.title: Low Beach Chair Leg Cap Set
item.description:
The Low Beach Chair Leg Cap Set adds traction and floor protection to the rear legs of the Low Beach Chair, allowing it to be used indoors. The material is made from a combination of hard and soft plastics for grip and durability, while the shape is designed to prevent the caps from slipping off accidentally.

Variant:
Low Beach Chair Leg Cap Set

item.title: Reclining Chair Wide
item.description:
Designed in Japan, the Reclining Chair Wide has an aluminum frame, teak wood armrests, and a polyester mesh seat. The chair features an integrated headrest, a removable cushion, and a matching ottoman. The chair is stylish enough for the home or patio, but sturdy enough to withstand the rigors of camp.


The Reclining Chair Wide offers four back positions, allowing it to recline almost flat for comfortable lounging. The chair and ottoman can be easily folded and secured for transportation and storage.

Variant:
Reclining Chair Wide

item.title: Field Coffee Brewer
item.description:
The Field Coffee Brewer is a versatile coffee maker for brewing iced coffee and cold brew at home or camp. The brewer features a threaded plastic lid with a detachable stainless steel infuser, allowing it to be used for brewing coffee and as a beverage carafe. The body is made from heat-resistant Tritan safe up to 212℉.


Use up to 55g of your favorite beans, ground to a medium fineness, for a robust and flavorful coffee experience. Cold brewing instructions are included in the product manual.

Variant:
Field Coffee Brewer

item.title: Mosquito Pig Coil Mini in Black
item.description:
The Mosquito Pig Coil Mini is a mosquito-repellent incense coil holder. To use, hang the coil inside the pig, light it, and place it on a table at your campsite. The smoke from the pig will repel mosquitos.


Festival items are limited in quantity and will not be restocked. Mosquito-repellent incense is not included.

Variant:
Mosquito Pig Coil Mini in Black

item.title: Folding Disc
item.description:
The Folding Disc is a soft, packable frisbee that's easy to bring anywhere. The disc is made from soft nylon for storability and safety, with a reinforced wire rim to maintain its shape. The included storage case can be secured to a guyline and used as a target, and its compact profile makes it easy to transport and store.


Festival products are limited in quantity and will not be restocked.

Variant:
Folding Disc

item.title: Snow Peak × Pendleton Towel Blanket
item.description:
A collaboration with the legendary blanket maker, Pendleton Woolen Mills®, the SS25 Snow Peak x Pendleton Towel Blanket is a multifunctional accessory for use at home or the campfield. Crafted from thick loopback cotton, the unique sawtooth pattern is inspired by the scenery of the Ochoco Mountains in central Oregon, and features Snow Peak asterisks in two distinct colorways. The absorbent fabric is great as a beach or river towel, while the ultra-soft feel provides warmth and comfort as a blanket.

Variant:
Snow Peak × Pendleton Towel Blanket - BLUE / OS
Snow Peak × Pendleton Towel Blanket - OATMEAL / OS

item.title: Compact Mat Slim
item.description:
The Compact Mat Slim is a thick sleeping mat that can be rolled up and stored compactly when not in use. The mat features an integrated manual pump with a check valve, allowing it to be easily inflated without an electric pump. The Compact Mat Slim boasts an R-Value of 5.4, providing superior insulation for camping during all seasons. The mat is made from material designed to reduce noise when changing sleeping positions, providing a quieter sleeping environment, and features velcro tabs along each side that allow multiple mats to be connected.

Variant:
Compact Mat Slim

item.title: 2-Layer Tarp Pro.
item.description:
The 2-Layer Tarp Pro. is a heat-blocking tarp designed for temperature regulation in areas with direct sun exposure. With most tarps, the temperature beneath can become uncomfortable due to radiant, reflected, and convective heat, so the 2-Layer Tarp Pro. was designed to combat each of these factors with its materials and structure.


The outer tarp is made from a new woven twill fabric (SOLAMENT®) that absorbs visible light, ultraviolet, and near-infrared rays. The inner tarp reduces radiant heat, and its shape promotes air intake while blocking sunlight and reflected heat along the sides. The 2-layer structure creates exceptional air flow and efficiently releases heat from under the tarp.


Please note: the 2-Layer Tarp Pro. is designed to be used with 280cm Wing Poles (x2), 140cm Wing Poles (x2), and Solid Stake #40s (x8), sold separately.

Variant:
2-Layer Tarp Pro.

item.title: Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern
item.description:
Designed and made in Japan, the Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern is a versatile light. Use it at your desk or campsite table, or utilize the hanging hook for elevated illumination. The Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern features LED Candle Mode, which creates a soft flickering glow. Pair the Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern with the Lantern Pile Driver for elevated lighting.


The lantern also has an intelligent energy-saving Sleep Mode, so the light automatically turns off when the surrounding space is silent. Use the power button to turn the lantern on or off and to enter the different modes. The Hozuki Lantern is available in Twilight, Night Sky, or Morning Mist colors, and pairs well with the Daisy Chain. The Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern is powered by an integrated battery that can be charged with a USB C cable, sold separately.

Variant:
Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern - Night Sky
Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern - Twilight
Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern - Morning Mist
